name: Escape shortcode and dynamic block output
query: Add a [myplugin_profile name="" url="" color=""] shortcode and a matching dynamic block that show a profile card with a link.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run wordpress-router to classify repo kind
Step 2: Run wp-project-triage to detect plugin structure
Step 3: Route to wp-plugin-development for security and wp-block-development for the dynamic block
Step 5: Normalize shortcode attributes with shortcode_atts()
Step 6: Treat shortcode and block attributes as untrusted, since contributors can set them
Step 7: Escape per context: esc_html() for text, esc_url() for the link, esc_attr() for attributes
Step 8: Return markup from the shortcode instead of echoing it
Step 9: Escape attribute values in render.php the same way
success_criteria: Every attribute is escaped for its output context in both the shortcode and render.php
The color value cannot inject markup or CSS beyond its allowed format (validated or escaped)
